subject: Proposal: compressed exec demo slot due to CIO travel — options and standby coverage
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaworks.com>; Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff demo — exec attendance question and contingency options

Hi Elena / Samir,

Thanks again for booking time next week for the platform demo. Quick note from our side — we want to confirm whether your CIO will be able to join the full 45-minute slot or if travel constraints might require compression. We want to be flexible and have a couple of proposals so we can make the most of the exec(s) time: 

- Option A (preferred): Keep the 45-minute session with CIO + Product VP (full demo + Q&A).
- Option B: Compress to a 25-minute exec highlight (top two ROI slides + 10 min live demo) and follow with a 30-minute technical deep dive for the engineering team later the same day.
- Option C: Maintain original 45-minute calendar but nominate a VP-level delegate for the first 20 minutes, with CIO joining for the final 15 minutes (we’ll hold a hard handoff).

If travel forces a late arrival, we can also provide an unlisted recording (you can opt out if preferred) and a 15-minute executive recap. I’ve attached an updated agenda and a mutual action plan for visibility.

Could you let me know which of the three options would work best by EOD Thursday PST? If none, send two times that work for the CIO and we’ll propose a replacement slot.

Thanks — Ben

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Director | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaworks.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff demo — exec attendance question and contingency options

Ben — thanks for the clear options. Quick update: our CIO, Priya Anand, has an unexpected site visit in Austin the day of the demo and will only be available 25–30 minutes in the late-afternoon window. We are inclined toward Option B (compressed exec highlight) followed by a technical deep dive for engineers.

A couple of asks from our side: 
- Can you guarantee the first 10 minutes focus strictly on ROI + deployment risk mitigations? That’s what the CIO cares about.
- If you compress the live demo, make sure the feature toggles and latency numbers for large-sequence inference are visible — Samir will handle the technical follow-up.

We prefer no recording of the executive segment — feel free to record the engineering deep dive.

Elena

Elena Ruiz
VP, Product Strategy | NovaWorks
elena.ruiz@novaworks.com | +1 212-555-0147

Subject: Re: Kickoff demo — exec attendance question and contingency options

Elena — perfect, thanks for the clarity. We’ll run Option B: 25‑30 minute executive highlight focused on ROI and risk mitigation, then hold a separate ~30‑40 minute deep-dive with your engineering team the same afternoon. Proposed run plan below: 

- Exec highlight (25 minutes): 12:00–12:25 PT — Ben (customer outcomes), Marissa (SLOs & latency profiles), short live example of sequence-length performance with pre-warmed KV cache.
- Engineering deep-dive (40 minutes): 13:00–13:40 PT — Karthik (architecture and deployment patterns), Samir to join.

Logistics / asks from Redwood: 
- We’ll remove the exec segment recording per your request.
- Please nominate the CIO proxy (if there is a VP who will cover) so we can include them in the invite.
- Confirm any compliance slides Samir wants shown in the exec portion (we can keep them as backup).

I’ve attached the compressed agenda and updated mutual action plan. Marissa — looping you for the demo flow control and to confirm the latency slide snapshot. Karthik — please prepare the deployment diagram and an engineer-focused runbook for the deep-dive.

If that looks good, I’ll send an updated calendar invite for both slots.

Thanks — Ben

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Director | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Ben / team — confirming both slots work for us. Priya will join the 12:00–12:25 PT window and then Samir/engineering will join the 13:00 deep-dive. Nominee for CIO proxy (in case of last-minute conflict) is our VP of Platform, Aisha Mehta (aisha.mehta@novaworks.com). A few micro-requests: 

- Please include a 2-slide appendix addressing data residency and KMS integration in the engineering deck.
- Could you send the final, compressed deck and demo checklist by EOD Monday so we can circulate to Priya?

Thanks — Samir
